author: Kaylee Barbee
title: Hurricane Isaias expected to become a Category 3 Friday AM - NewsBreak
text:
By Kaylee Barbee ,
6 hours ago
COLUMBUS, Ga. ( WRBL ) — Hurricane Isaias is now a Category 2 storm with wind gusts up to 120mph. We also have new Tropical Storm Warnings: Bullock, Barbour, Macon. Clay County remains under a Tropical Storm Warning. The rest of the area is under a Tropical Storm Watch.
Hurricane Isaias is now expected to be a Category 3 hurricane Friday morning.
On its current track, Isaias will make landfall Friday PM near Pensacola, Florida. Please stay weather-aware. Our conditions will start deteriorate here in Columbus, Ga shortly after 7PM ET.
Impacts: Storm surge warnings have been issued along the coast ahead of Isaias’ landfall. Damaging winds are possible further inland. We will be looking at sustained winds above 40mph for several hours, with gusts even higher.
Because of the unique set up of this tropical system, we have an increased risk for tornadoes across East Alabama and West Georgia.
A big concern for the Southeast is heavy rainfall. Totals between 3 and 6 inches are likely, with higher amounts possible. Isolated tornadoes will also be possible within the bands of Isaias.
